StreamDeckSetTitle.description: Changes the text on a Stream Deck key. Find the key by the Button ID you set on it in Stream Deck. Add a state (0 or 1) to change only that state's title.

StreamDeckSetValue.description: Changes the value shown on a Stream Deck key or dial, found by its Button ID.

StreamDeckSetState.description: Switches a two-state Stream Deck key to state 0 or state 1, found by its Button ID.

StreamDeckToggleState.description: Flips a two-state Stream Deck key to its other state, found by its Button ID.

StreamDeckShowAlert.description: Flashes the warning icon on a Stream Deck key, found by its Button ID. Handy to show that something failed.

StreamDeckShowOk.description: Flashes the check mark icon on a Stream Deck key, found by its Button ID. Handy to show that something worked.

StreamDeckSetBackgroundColor.description: Fills a Stream Deck key with one colour, like "#FF0000" or "red". Add a state (0 or 1) to colour only that state.

StreamDeckSetBackgroundLocal.description: Shows a picture file from your computer on a Stream Deck key. Add a state (0 or 1) to change only that state. The colour setting is ignored in Cuebot.

StreamDeckSetBackgroundUrl.description: Shows a picture from a web link on a Stream Deck key. Add a state (0 or 1) to change only that state. The colour setting is ignored in Cuebot.

VTubeStudioTriggerHotkeyById.description: Presses a VTube Studio hotkey. Cuebot finds it by its id or by its name.
VTubeStudioTriggerHotkeyById.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed (a warning goes to the log).

VTubeStudioTriggerHotkeyByName.description: Presses a VTube Studio hotkey by its name, like "Wave". An id works too.
VTubeStudioTriggerHotkeyByName.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed (a warning goes to the log).

VTubeStudioLoadModelById.description: Loads a different VTube Studio model. Cuebot finds it by its id or by its name.
VTubeStudioLoadModelById.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed.

VTubeStudioLoadModelByName.description: Loads a different VTube Studio model by its name, like "Cat Form". An id works too.
VTubeStudioLoadModelByName.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed.
VTubeStudioLoadModelByName.example:
bool ok = CPH.VTubeStudioLoadModelByName("Cat Form");
CPH.LogInfo($"Model loaded: {ok}");

VTubeStudioActivateExpression.description: Turns on a VTube Studio expression. Give its file name, like "Happy.exp3.json".
VTubeStudioActivateExpression.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed.

VTubeStudioDeactivateExpression.description: Turns off a VTube Studio expression. Give its file name, like "Happy.exp3.json".
VTubeStudioDeactivateExpression.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed.

VTubeStudioGetModelPosition.description: Asks VTube Studio where your model is: its X and Y position, rotation and size.
VTubeStudioGetModelPosition.returns: The position (PositionX, PositionY, Rotation, Size), or null when VTube Studio did not answer.
VTubeStudioGetModelPosition.example:
var pos = CPH.VTubeStudioGetModelPosition();
if (pos != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Model at {pos.PositionX}, {pos.PositionY}, size {pos.Size}");

VTubeStudioMoveModel.description: Moves your VTube Studio model over a number of seconds (0 to 2). With relative true, it moves from where it is now. Leave a value out to keep it as it is.
VTubeStudioMoveModel.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed.

VTubeStudioColorTintAll.description: Tints your whole VTube Studio model one colour, like "#FF8800" (add two more digits for see-through). Mix with scene lighting goes from 0 to 1.
VTubeStudioColorTintAll.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the colour was not #RRGGBB.

VTubeStudioColorTintByNames.description: Tints only the model parts (art meshes) whose names match exactly. Colour like "#00FF00", scene lighting mix 0 to 1.
VTubeStudioColorTintByNames.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the colour was not #RRGGBB.

VTubeStudioColorTintByNameContains.description: Tints only the model parts (art meshes) whose names contain one of your words. Colour like "#00FF00", scene lighting mix 0 to 1.
VTubeStudioColorTintByNameContains.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the colour was not #RRGGBB.

VTubeStudioColorTintByTags.description: Tints only the model parts (art meshes) whose tags match exactly. Colour like "#0000FF", scene lighting mix 0 to 1.
VTubeStudioColorTintByTags.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the colour was not #RRGGBB.

VTubeStudioColorTintByTagContains.description: Tints only the model parts (art meshes) whose tags contain one of your words. Colour like "#0000FF", scene lighting mix 0 to 1.
VTubeStudioColorTintByTagContains.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the colour was not #RRGGBB.

VTubeStudioColorTintByNumber.description: Tints only the model parts (art meshes) with the numbers you list. Colour like "#FF00FF", scene lighting mix 0 to 1.
VTubeStudioColorTintByNumber.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the colour was not #RRGGBB.

VTubeStudioRandomColorTint.description: Tints your whole VTube Studio model one random colour. Fun for a channel point reward.
VTubeStudioRandomColorTint.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed.

VTubeStudioResetAllColorTints.description: Removes all colour tints, so your model looks normal again (tints it plain white).
VTubeStudioResetAllColorTints.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed.

VTubeStudioSendRawRequest.description: Sends any VTube Studio request by its type name, with its data written as JSON text. For advanced users who know the VTube Studio API.
VTubeStudioSendRawRequest.returns: The answer's data as JSON text, or empty text when it failed.

VoiceModSelectVoice.description: Switches Voicemod to another voice. Cuebot finds it by its id or by its name.
VoiceModSelectVoice.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

VoiceModGetCurrentVoice.description: Asks Voicemod which voice is picked right now.
VoiceModGetCurrentVoice.returns: The voice's id, or empty text when Voicemod did not answer.

VoiceModVoiceChangerOn.description: Turns the Voicemod voice changer on.
VoiceModVoiceChangerOn.returns: true when the voice changer is now on, otherwise false.
VoiceModVoiceChangerOn.example:
bool on = CPH.VoiceModVoiceChangerOn();
CPH.LogInfo($"Voice changer on: {on}");

VoiceModVoiceChangerOff.description: Turns the Voicemod voice changer off.
VoiceModVoiceChangerOff.returns: true when the voice changer is now off, otherwise false.

VoiceModHearMyVoiceOn.description: Turns on "hear my voice" in Voicemod, so you hear yourself.
VoiceModHearMyVoiceOn.returns: true when it is now on, otherwise false.

VoiceModHearMyVoiceOff.description: Turns off "hear my voice" in Voicemod.
VoiceModHearMyVoiceOff.returns: true when it is now off, otherwise false.

VoiceModBackgroundEffectOn.returns: true when they are now on, otherwise false.

VoiceModBackgroundEffectOff.returns: true when they are now off, otherwise false.

VoiceModCensorOn.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

VoiceModCensorOff.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

VoiceModGetVoiceChangerStatus.description: Checks whether the Voicemod voice changer is on, as Voicemod last told Cuebot.
VoiceModGetVoiceChangerStatus.returns: true when it is on; false when it is off or not known yet.
VoiceModGetVoiceChangerStatus.example:
bool on = CPH.VoiceModGetVoiceChangerStatus();
CPH.LogInfo($"Voice changer on: {on}");

VoiceModGetHearMyselfStatus.description: Checks whether "hear myself" is on in Voicemod, as Voicemod last told Cuebot.
VoiceModGetHearMyselfStatus.returns: true when it is on; false when it is off or not known yet.

WaveLinkGetInputIdentifier.description: Finds the id of a Wave Link input (channel) by its name, like "Game". Other Wave Link methods need this id.
WaveLinkGetInputIdentifier.returns: The input's id, or empty text when there is no input with that name.

WaveLinkGetMicrophoneIdentifier.description: Finds the id of a microphone in Wave Link by its name.
WaveLinkGetMicrophoneIdentifier.returns: The microphone's id, or empty text when there is none with that name.

WaveLinkInputMute.description: Mutes a Wave Link input in one mixer: "Local" (or "Monitor") for what you hear, "Stream" for what viewers hear.
WaveLinkInputMute.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkInputUnmute.description: Unmutes a Wave Link input in one mixer: "Local" (or "Monitor") or "Stream".
WaveLinkInputUnmute.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkInputToggleMute.description: Flips a Wave Link input between muted and unmuted in one mixer: "Local" (or "Monitor") or "Stream".
WaveLinkInputToggleMute.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkInputSetVolume.description: Sets a Wave Link input's volume in one mixer, from 0 to 100.
WaveLinkInputSetVolume.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkInputGetVolume.description: Reads a Wave Link input's volume in one mixer (0 to 100). The input can be given by id or name.
WaveLinkInputGetVolume.returns: The volume as a whole number, or 0 when it is not known.

WaveLinkInputFilterEnable.description: Turns on one filter (effect) of a Wave Link input. Give the input id and the filter id.
WaveLinkInputFilterEnable.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkInputFilterDisable.description: Turns off one filter (effect) of a Wave Link input. Give the input id and the filter id.
WaveLinkInputFilterDisable.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkInputFilterToggle.description: Flips one filter (effect) of a Wave Link input on or off. Give the input id and the filter id.
WaveLinkInputFilterToggle.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkInputGetFilterIdentifier.description: Finds the id of a filter (effect) on a Wave Link input by the filter's name.
WaveLinkInputGetFilterIdentifier.returns: The filter's id, or empty text when there is none with that name.

WaveLinkInputGetFilterState.description: Checks whether a filter (effect) on a Wave Link input is turned on. The filter can be given by id or name.
WaveLinkInputGetFilterState.returns: true when the filter is on, otherwise false.

WaveLinkInputFilterBypassBypassed.description: Skips every filter of a Wave Link input in one mixer ("Local" or "Stream"), so it sounds dry.
WaveLinkInputFilterBypassBypassed.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkInputFilterBypassEnabled.description: Stops skipping the filters of a Wave Link input in one mixer ("Local" or "Stream"), so they run again.
WaveLinkInputFilterBypassEnabled.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkInputFilterBypassToggle.description: Flips filter skipping (bypass) of a Wave Link input on or off in one mixer ("Local" or "Stream").
WaveLinkInputFilterBypassToggle.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkInputSetFilterBypassBypassed.description: Same as WaveLinkInputFilterBypassBypassed: skips every filter of the input in one mixer.
WaveLinkInputSetFilterBypassBypassed.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkInputSetFilterBypassEnabled.description: Same as WaveLinkInputFilterBypassEnabled: the input's filters run again in one mixer.
WaveLinkInputSetFilterBypassEnabled.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkInputSetFilterBypassToggle.description: Same as WaveLinkInputFilterBypassToggle: flips filter skipping of the input in one mixer.
WaveLinkInputSetFilterBypassToggle.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkMicrophoneMute.description: Mutes a microphone in Wave Link. Give the microphone's id.
WaveLinkMicrophoneMute.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkMicrophoneUnmute.description: Unmutes a microphone in Wave Link. Give the microphone's id.
WaveLinkMicrophoneUnmute.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkMicrophoneToggleMute.description: Flips a Wave Link microphone between muted and unmuted. Give the microphone's id.
WaveLinkMicrophoneToggleMute.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkMicrophoneSetVolume.description: Sets a microphone's gain (how loud it picks you up). Wave Link 3 uses percent (0 to 100); older Wave Link uses the microphone's own scale.
WaveLinkMicrophoneSetVolume.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkMicrophoneGetVolume.description: Reads a microphone's gain (how loud it picks you up) from Wave Link.
WaveLinkMicrophoneGetVolume.returns: The gain as a number, or 0 when it is not known.

WaveLinkOutputMute.description: Mutes a whole Wave Link mixer: "Local" (or "Monitor") for what you hear, "Stream" for what viewers hear.
WaveLinkOutputMute.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkOutputUnmute.description: Unmutes a whole Wave Link mixer: "Local" (or "Monitor") or "Stream".
WaveLinkOutputUnmute.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkOutputToggleMute.description: Flips a whole Wave Link mixer between muted and unmuted: "Local" (or "Monitor") or "Stream".
WaveLinkOutputToggleMute.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

WaveLinkSetOutputVolume.description: Sets the volume of a whole Wave Link mixer ("Local" or "Stream"), from 0 to 100.
WaveLinkSetOutputVolume.returns: Nothing. A failure only writes a warning to the log.

LumiaSendCommand.description: Runs a Lumia Stream chat command, like "rainbow", to change your lights. Empty text does nothing.

LumiaSetToDefault.description: Puts your Lumia Stream lights back to their normal (default) look.

MidiSendNoteOn.description: Plays a MIDI note on one of Cuebot's MIDI Out connections, found by its id. Channel 1 to 16, note and velocity 0 to 127. Add a time in milliseconds and true to stop the note after that time.

MidiSendNoteOnByName.description: Plays a MIDI note on a MIDI Out connection, found by its name. Channel 1 to 16, note and velocity 0 to 127. Add a time in milliseconds and true to stop the note after that time.

MidiSendControlChange.description: Sends a MIDI control change (like moving a knob) on a MIDI Out connection, found by its id. Channel 1 to 16, controller and value 0 to 127.

MidiSendControlChangeByName.description: Sends a MIDI control change (like moving a knob) on a MIDI Out connection, found by its name. Channel 1 to 16, controller and value 0 to 127.

MidiSendRaw.description: Sends one raw MIDI message on a MIDI Out connection, found by its id. The command is the message kind, like 0x90 for Note On. For advanced users.

MidiSendRawByName.description: Sends one raw MIDI message on a MIDI Out connection, found by its name. The command is the message kind, like 0x90 for Note On or 0xB0 for a control change.

ThrowingSystemThrowItemByName.description: Throws an item at your model in T.I.T.S., by the item's name. You can set how many times and the seconds between throws.
ThrowingSystemThrowItemByName.returns: true when T.I.T.S. threw it, otherwise false.

ThrowingSystemActivateTriggerByName.description: Starts a trigger you set up in T.I.T.S., by its name.
ThrowingSystemActivateTriggerByName.returns: true when T.I.T.S. accepted it, false when it failed or the name was empty.
ThrowingSystemActivateTriggerByName.example:
bool ok = CPH.ThrowingSystemActivateTriggerByName("Rain of Hearts");
CPH.LogInfo($"Trigger started: {ok}");
